DIRTY_TREE: The release checkout contains uncommitted work.
HOLD_VERDICT: The current review explicitly refuses shipment.
INVALID_VERSION: The requested release is not an exact semantic version.
INVALID_VERDICT: The review verdict is neither ship nor hold.
MISSING_RELEASE_PAGE: The version has no plain-language release page.
MISSING_REVIEW: The version has no exact-SHA review evidence.
STALE_REVIEW: The review does not name the candidate's exact SHA.
TAG_CONFLICT: The requested tag already names another commit.
UNPUSHED_TIP: The local candidate is not the pushed build-line tip.
UNANNOTATED_TAG: The release ref is a lightweight tag rather than an annotated tag.
WRONG_BUILD_BRANCH: The version does not match the active build branch.
